metric_definition.summary_unit: trial per condition/speed/wheel; planned n=5; sample SD
metric_definition.invalid_values: null with reason; never replace missing time metrics with zero
metric_definition.synthetic_data_policy: tests only; never real data directory
metric_definition.diameter_basis_note: Actual diameter 0.065 m explicitly confirmed by user; measuring method unspecified and recorded in hardware manifest.
metric_definition.calibration_method_note: One manually marked forward output-wheel revolution per wheel, net signed count. Human mark-alignment uncertainty is not instrument calibration. Feedback remains the original source conversion using nominal 60000 counts per output revolution.
metric_definition.lock_status: Locked prospectively before the first formal run; calibration and operator-confirmed hardware correspondence recorded. No later band widening.
